note: Ceiling for internal/controlplane, in hand-written non-test Go lines. Build-ignored tools and generated DO-NOT-EDIT output are reported but not counted; see scripts/report-migration-progress.mjs. The bounded-context migration may only move this down. Raising it requires saying why in the same commit.
reason: Lowered by 525 when Governance took ownership of its own decisions rather than only its types: the approval-policy language and its published CEL predicates, the audit category contract, the scope-expanded grant lookup, and reviewer-requirement satisfaction all moved to internal/governance as a domain, one port and an application service. The facade keeps the Change Request lifecycle that asks those questions and now asks them through the service, so no rule has a second copy. Set to exactly the current count rather than a round number, so the next line of growth still has to justify itself. The previous 26077 was recorded on 2026-08-14 on the same counting basis and is directly comparable.
